items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: The Battle House Mobile was pecked, S.H. Peck.

ctx.x: North of Pensacola. North of Pensacola. Yeah, that's right. And you played there in Florida town, didn't you? Oh, yeah.

Played there. We used to make a regular tour of that. Mobile, Pensacola, Florida town, all of those that come in. The owner who manages me at the familiar Florida town was Burgess Pace, wasn't it? Yeah. The Battle House Mobile was pecked, S.H. Peck. That one would pecked himself. It says something about the dance at the Mary Gardens tonight.
Purple Derby's present Mr. L.E. Clough, New Ideas and Trumpets Information. I never heard of L.E. Clough.
